result: When the clock started, Priya grabbed the pad and announced a fish: "The tail fin is the giveaway." She laid the fin first, connected it back to the start, then built the body from the tail base, top and bottom. The top reached the nose, but the bottom came up short, so she kept extending it. Nobody was free to draw the eye, so it was skipped. Near the end she spotted the trouble: "that little group up top isn't joined." She nudged the join, then saw the nose end was still pale and not connected to the start. With the push coming, she made her final call: "I'm leaving everything alone now." When the start domino went, 25 of 31 fell. Priya had warned that the head would probably drop off. Blind judges, though, guessed a chevron or arrow pointing right, a bent line that didn't look like a fish at all.
